decisions.statement: The checkout sits where the scratch world puts it.
Every body the checkout is asked for is written where that body's path says.
What a body the checkout is asked for imports is filed beside the page imported.
The page the import edge is sits in the checkout too.
A page named in the checkout is answered under its page type and slug.
A page named in the checkout is answered under its id as well.
A change over the checkout reads what it carries, then what it was handed, then the disk.
A change made from bodies alone reads those bodies both before and after.
No git tree is made here.
The checkout has the page type its pages are, so what a file belongs to is answered.
That page type is the page itself rather than a page the fixture invents.
That page sits outside the tree a check reads, so no check is handed a file more.

definition: the scratch checkout a check's test runs over
